lines.beaver: 요즘 바쁘죠? 동아리 활동은 어떻게 해요?
lines.beaver_en: You're busy these days, right? How's club activity going?
lines.beaver_roman: Yojeum bappeujyo? Dongari hwaldongeun eotteoke haeyo?
lines.learner: 바쁜데도 불구하고 동아리 활동은 꼭 해요.
lines.en: Even though I'm busy, I never miss club activities.
lines.roman: Bappeundedo bulguhago dongari hwaldongeun kkok haeyo.

lines.beaver: 대단하네요. 여가 시간에는 주로 뭘 해요?
lines.beaver_en: Impressive. What do you usually do in your free time?
lines.beaver_roman: Daedanhaneyo. Yeoga siganeneun juro mwol haeyo?
lines.en: In my free time, I read novels and write poems.

lines.beaver_en: Do you have a favorite novelist?
lines.en: I've read all of Kim Young-ha's books.

lines.beaver_en: I heard you collect poetry books too. Is collecting your hobby?
lines.learner: 네, 시집 수집이 제 오랜 취미예요.
lines.en: Yes, collecting poetry books is my long-time hobby.
lines.roman: Ne, sijip sujibi je oraen chwimiyeyo.

lines.beaver_en: How many do you have now?
lines.learner: 백 권쯤 있어요. 올해만 열 권 늘었어요.
lines.en: About a hundred. I got ten more this year alone.
lines.roman: Baek gwonjjeum isseoyo. Olhaeman yeol gwon neureosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Wow, isn't your place getting cramped?
lines.learner: 방이 작은데도 불구하고 책장을 또 샀어요.
lines.en: Even though my room is small, I bought another bookshelf.
lines.roman: Bangi jageundedo bulguhago chaekjangeul tto sasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Haha. Did you major in literature?
lines.en: No, I loved literature even though I was an engineering student.

lines.beaver: 요즘 야근도 많다면서요? 그래도 계속 읽어요?
lines.beaver_en: I heard you work late a lot. Do you still keep reading?
lines.beaver_roman: Yojeum yageundo mantamyeonseoyo? Geuraedo gyesok ilgeoyo?
lines.learner: 야근하는데도 불구하고 자기 전에 꼭 읽어요.
lines.en: Even though I work late, I always read before bed.
lines.roman: Yageunhaneundedo bulguhago jagi jeone kkok ilgeoyo.

lines.beaver: 다음 달에 동아리 공동 시집을 낼까 해요.
lines.beaver_en: We're thinking of publishing a joint club poetry book next month.
lines.beaver_roman: Daeum dare dongari gongdong sijibeul naelkka haeyo.
lines.en: A joint poetry book? I'll definitely join in!

lines.beaver_en: Thanks. See you at the Saturday meeting, then!
lines.learner: 네, 토요일에 새 시를 가지고 갈게요.
lines.en: Okay, I'll bring a new poem on Saturday.
lines.roman: Ne, toyoire sae sireul gajigo galgeyo.
